definition: to lock something or someone up
description: In a bank vault in a basement corridor lit by harsh white and red light, a man in a black uniform shirt and trousers braces his legs and pushes a huge round steel vault door shut, gripping its spoked wheel handle with both hands. At first metal shelves inside hold a sparkling diamond and small boxes, then the heavy door swings closed over them. Security guards in dark uniforms stand at the end of the corridor at first, next to a steel trolley at the foot of a staircase.

en.question: What is the man heaving shut?

es.answer: Está cerrando con fuerza la puerta de la cámara acorazada.
es.question: ¿Qué está cerrando con fuerza el hombre?

fr.answer: Il ferme la porte du coffre-fort de toutes ses forces.
phrases: fermer la porte de toutes ses forces
fr.question: Que ferme l'homme de toutes ses forces ?
